projects.name: QueryCraft
projects.description: A local-first natural-language-to-SQL workbench. It generates schema-grounded SQL, lets you review and edit it, and runs only validated read-only SQLite queries. It has a schema explorer, CSV export and a no-key demo mode.
highlights: SQLGlot validation pipeline with user-approved, read-only execution, query deadlines and row limits
Verified through 92 AI automated tests and browser regression checks
Five no-key demo questions on a bundled synthetic ecommerce database

projects.name: Brazilian Olist E-Commerce Reporting
projects.description: A Power BI report on the Brazilian Olist e-commerce dataset with revenue, map and customer analytics views, built to showcase Power BI skills. It uses a custom theme matching the colors of the Brazilian flag.
highlights: Measures for customer counts, total revenue, total orders, average order value and average orders per customer
Revenue, map and customer analytics views

projects.name: US Consumer Credit Analysis
projects.description: An analysis of the Federal Reserve G.19 Consumer Credit release (Jan 1943 to Jun 2026) comparing revolving and nonrevolving credit. It ships as a notebook with 7 charts and written findings, and as an interactive Streamlit dashboard.
highlights: Year-over-year growth of the two series correlates at only 0.16
Revolving share fell from 41.2% (Apr 1998) to 22.5% (Jun 2021)
Student loans grew 286% since 2006 and are now 49% of nonrevolving credit

projects.name: sliceguard
projects.description: A fairness slice auditor that puts Wilson and Newcombe intervals on every slice, applies Benjamini-Hochberg correction across all slices tested, and reports a minimum detectable effect. Tiny slices stop producing false alarms, and underpowered ones are marked INDETERMINATE.
highlights: Demo audits 6,000 synthetic underwriting-model evaluations with two planted 9-point disparities
Ranks by the lower bound of the gap interval instead of the raw point estimate
Standard library only, with calibration tests for false discovery rate and power

projects.name: purgedcv
projects.description: Purged, embargoed walk-forward cross-validation for time series, plus a harness that measures how much of a backtest's reported skill is leakage. It scores one model under four protocols on synthetic data where the true skill is known, including a zero-signal control.
highlights: On a zero-signal series, naive k-fold overstated accuracy by 8.35 percentage points
The label horizon is mandatory, so overlap leakage cannot be reintroduced by default
28 tests; pure standard-library Python

projects.name: fieldvoice
projects.description: An offline speech-to-structured-report pipeline evaluated on entity error rate instead of word error rate, because only part numbers, fault codes and quantities matter. It adds catalogue-constrained decoding that snaps identifiers or routes them to a human. Recognition is simulated.
highlights: In the demo, WER prefers the system that fumbles every field (0.192 vs 0.231); entity error rate prefers the other (0.833 vs 0.000)
Entity error rate reported overall and per entity type
80 tests; pure Python standard library

projects.name: quantfrontier
projects.description: A quantisation quality/latency frontier measured per downstream task and by output divergence instead of perplexity. It uses real integer quantisation on a small MLP and a seeded simulated backend, and finds the bit width where task quality falls off a cliff.
highlights: Per-task Pareto frontiers over quality, latency and memory
KL divergence against full precision as an early-warning signal
29 tests; no LLM or model weights required, and results are not real-LLM benchmarks

projects.name: tamperlog
projects.description: A hash-chained audit log with periodic Merkle checkpoints whose roots are held in a separate witness store. It detects re-chained truncation and edits that plain hash chaining accepts, and reports the exact sequence range affected.
highlights: On a 20,000-entry log with a checkpoint every 1,000 entries, chain-only checks missed 3 of 7 tamper classes; with checkpoints all 7 were detected
Inclusion proofs for any entry, with domain-separated leaf and node hashes
Standard library only, no dependencies

projects.name: yaraci
projects.description: A CI harness for YARA rule quality. It lints rules, proves each rule fires on its own fixtures, scans goodware for false positives, profiles scan cost and diffs two rule-set versions by what they match, then returns one exit code.
highlights: 35 lint check codes plus per-rule scorecards graded from A to F
Reports as text, Markdown, JSON, JUnit XML and SARIF 2.1.0
259 tests; runs on both the YARA-X and libyara engines
